data.text: [00:03.8]I’m really excited about this weekend … I think it’s going to be difficult, but I’m sure we’re all going to have a great time.

[00:11.6]Yes … I’m really looking forward to it as well. `[00:15.5]I’ve always wanted to go on one of these survival courses. `[00:20]It might be a bit strange going with a group of people who you don’t know very well. `[00:25]But I suppose it’s good to get to know our colleagues better!
[00:29.4]Yes, I think that’s the idea … I’m sure it’ll be fun.
[00:33.8]Anyway, we can take five things, can’t we? `[00:37]Shall we think about it now … and try and decide which things to take?
[00:44.7]Erm … which of them do you think is the most important?
[00:49.7]Well, it’s quite cold … erm … I don’t want to be cold at night! I think we should take the blankets to keep us warm.
[00:59]OK … so, do you think they’re more important than the penknife?
[01:04.2]No, no … not more important. `[01:07.2]We can have the penknife as well. `[01:10]We are allowed five things after all.
[01:15.3]Well, in my opinion, we should take the matches, so we can make a fire from all the wood you can chop up with the penknife!
[01:23]Good idea … and … how about the tent?
[01:27.3]Hmmm … I’m not sure. That sounds like cheating a bit. `[01:31.9]Couldn’t we make a shelter from the trees and leaves and things?
[01:37.5]OK … we’ll have the tent … and why don’t we have the chocolate as number five as a bit of luxury?
[01:44]Yes, great idea … I think we’re going to need it!
